hook_text: Five steps, three levers, one brace, one loop. That is a whole year of Technology, and you already know it.
clip_script: Here is Grade 7 Technology in one minute. Five steps: investigate, design, make, evaluate, communicate. Every project, same five. Three levers: look at what sits in the middle. Pivot in the middle, seesaw, first class. Load in the middle, wheelbarrow, second class, always makes you stronger. Effort in the middle, tweezers, third class, never stronger but fast. Syringes: small pushes big, big moves slow but strong. Frames: a rectangle folds flat, one diagonal makes two triangles and it stops folding. Circuits: cell, wire, switch, lamp, complete loop or nothing happens. Wrap wire round a nail, switch on, you have an electromagnet. The baseline assessment this week just checks these are still in your head. They are. Prove it.
visual_style: Whiteboard splits into five quick panels: the IDMEC letters, three lever stick diagrams, a pair of syringes, a rectangle gaining a diagonal, a circuit loop closing.
pacing: Five rapid beats of about ten seconds each, then a one-line challenge.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and label the pivot, load and effort on three tools in your kitchen.
